implications_for_icoder_a1b_ae_3: Corti Console Pre-built Agents are NOT directly listed in public docs — this REVERSE_ENGINEERED observation provides the ground-truth enumeration.
iCoDer Expert Registry (A1B-AE.3) can use the 9-key Corti public Expert registry (A1B-AE.1 §3.2) as the Expert-level reference; the 20 Pre-built Agents are Agent-level (one level above Experts).
The 2 Corti Agents without iCoDer equivalent (Clinical Education / Clinical Guidelines) should be noted in A1B-AE.8 scope or deferred to a later roadmap.

iCoDer's 13 Packs without Corti Pre-built equivalent (cdi-review, code-reconciler, discharge-summary-structuring, documentation-gap, drg-analyzer, evidence-extractor, evidence-ranker, index-navigator, medcoder-coding-review, principal-diagnosis-review, tabular-validator, etc.) are iCoDer-original capabilities — they do NOT need to be removed for parity.
implications_for_icoder_a1b_ae_8: A1B-AE.8 ships 5 iCoDer Preset Agents (per Charter §17). They MUST be tagged `origin=ICODER_CLEAN_ROOM` + `official_corti_preset=false`.

Selecting which 5 of the 20 Corti Pre-built Agents to model is an A1B-AE.8 design decision; the strongest candidates are Agents where iCoDer already has a working Pack: Medical Coding Agent, CDI Agent, Code Validation Agent, ICD-10 Index Navigator, Rule Explainer.
iCoDer's Preset Agent NAMES will differ from Corti's to preserve the clean-room stance (e.g. 'iCoDer 编码校验' rather than 'Code Validation Agent').
